spans.text: Griffin HQ, inside Kryuger's office.
...And that is everything we know about what's happening in Area S09.
The Military's actual main force has found an excuse to enter the region.
They are also declaring that this is a terrorist incident caused by a PMC going rogue, and the regular army is going to take over the administration of this entire region very soon.
...I knew it.
The first thing I considered was that the Military would use us as shields, then discard us to achieve their aims.
But in the end, they flat-out threw Griffin under the bus. Now they're trying to push us into a corner.
Carter's plan was more outrageous than I'd imagined.
...A nearby TV is reporting a major incident that occurred during a joint training exercise between the Military and a PMC.
General Carter is giving a statement on behalf of the Military.
Regarding the accident which occurred during this training exercise, there is no need for anyone to worry.
Our forces have activated our emergency response plan and the situation is currently under control.
Please be at ease. The Military has a firm grasp of the situation, and we will conduct a legal investigation to determine the parties responsible for this incident...
...Kryuger turns off the TV.
Helian, issue the evacuation orders as planned, then take everyone and go.
Mr. Kryuger, are you sure...you want to stay here?
They only need one scapegoat to help them finish acting out this farce.
Given the chaos on the battlefield, they cannot and need not shut down all of Griffin's frontline bases.
Griffin will not vanish as long as those commanders and T-Dolls are still around.
And those commanders will need someone to help them. Helian, I trust you know what I'm talking about.
I'm sure you will be safe.
Do I look like a man who'll let himself be taken without a fight?
Then take care, Mr. Kryuger.
I will lead everyone while we await your return.
...Helian bows and leaves the office.
Now then...
...Kryuger makes a personal call.
Havier, it's me.
I'd like to tell you something while we're still alive...
...At the same time, while withdrawing to Area S11.
...The Commander has just achieved victory.
We did it! Commander, your tactics were effective, and we finally beat those military units!
Now this route is safe, and everybody will be able to...
...Click.
Yes...alright...
Commander, there's information here which indicates that other Griffin T-Dolls besides ourselves are withdrawing too...
In relation to our current location, they're still behind us!
...Eh? You want us to escort them out of the contaminated zone?
Understood! Everyone will be a bit upset about getting home late, but we've got to do this!
Heheh, besides, not doing so just isn't our style. Let's hold this place and protect everyone!
